findings.issue: The condition `!this.compilation.ContainsSyntaxTree(...)` is inverted. It drops all diagnostics for the current compilation (violating REQ-2283-NF1 and REQ-2283-S1) and attempts to report diagnostics for syntax trees outside the compilation, which will crash the analyzer.

`GetPropertyIdentifierLocation` returns null for record properties because their syntax is `ParameterSyntax`, not `PropertyDeclarationSyntax`. This causes their diagnostics to lose location or be dropped entirely, violating REQ-2283-NF1 and contradicting Claim C10.
